title: Prism Separator
pages: Use the t6 Heliostat Etcher to make Solar Prisms from attuned quartz. Hand two Solar Prisms to an Astral Font with 280 lumen to make a Prism Mandala. Separately, weave a Woven Sigil at the Spectral Loom, bind a Reliquary Core at the Reliquary Stand, form a Concordance Seal at the Concordance Altar, and make an Iridescent Key at the Iridescent Basin. Condense Lunar Essence, grind a Ground Lens, relay the essence into an Astral Core, and build a Stellar Crucible. Craft this separator with one mandala, one further Solar Prism, one sealed steel plate (top left), a Worm Gear Set in the top-right slot, a Thrust Ball Bearing in the bottom-right slot as the spindle foot, a hopper, an etcher, an Iridescent Key, and a Stellar Crucible consumed as its fusion chamber. The thrust bearing carries the spinning bowl's axial load: flatten Bearing Steel Stock at the Flange Press into two Thrust Washer Blanks, harden two blanks in a Quench Vat (250 mB water, 120 ticks at 12 FE/t), then craft two Hardened Thrust Washers above and below a row of two bearing balls around an iron nugget cage. A deep groove ball bearing or a plain plate does not fit. These dependencies make ten distinct t6 devices necessary for the t7 unlock. For bearing grease, separate two raw porkchops into Rendered Tallow and a cooked porkchop byproduct. Combine the tallow with clay, then pack it into the Labyrinth Seal rings for the Prism Tumbler.

The Worm Gear Set is the separator's turret indexing drive: its low-lead steel worm turns the bronze wheel through a large reduction at right angles and holds the prism turret still against back-driving between separation steps. It belongs here rather than on the Heliostat Etcher because the Lens Grinder that cuts the worm is only reachable after the etcher. Thread-grind one Tool Steel Stock into a Ground Worm in the Lens Grinder (220 ticks, 18 FE/t), then craft four Sealed Steel Plates (two sides, two below the worm), the worm (top centre), a Sintered Bronze Gear from the Copper Hot Press (centre) and one Lubricating Oil from the Pressure Press (bottom centre). A bare sealed plate, unground stock or a loose bronze gear does not complete the separator. Ratio, efficiency and lead angle are not simulated, and self-locking is never treated as a safety brake.

Feed one block or prism into the left slot. The separator spends 20 FE/t for 140 ticks and yields a principal material plus a recovered residue in two independent output slots. Separating a solar prism produces the prism core for the next stage.

Twenty datapack recipes cover ores and aggregate recovery. JEI displays both results and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:separation accepts ingredient, count, result, byproduct, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import only items accepted by a loaded separation recipe; unmatched hopper items are rejected. Bottom exports both outputs. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if either output is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops all three slots.
